objective.name: semantic-dev-F0.5
objective.definition: maximize semanticLinguistic F0.5 on VSEC dev spelling labels under the recall-improvement plan's global acceptance gates
constraints: lane-local precision >= 0.70 before any lane activates
cross-lane dev semantic recall >= 0.2677 (+10 pp over 0.1677) before any lane activates
global semantic precision may not regress by more than 0.02
synthetic missing-diacritic recall drop <= 0.5 pp vs defaults
no new unexpected issue on the red-team clean corpus

search.method: shadow-decision replay grid + real in-process dev verification; pure deterministic selector (tools/calibrate_recall_lanes.mjs)

winner.interpretation: Full-grid verification fixed the truncated v2 search and found DIFFERENT_KEY_REAL_WORD p>=0.95/maxOriginalWindows=3 feasible. Word-boundary remains SHADOW pending separate attribution verification.

confidenceCalibration.fittedOn: vsec-dev through the real engine (serving prior)

wrongDiacriticBreakthrough.finding: ACCENTED_SAME_KEY (wrong diacritics) is 53% of real dev errors but sat at recall 0.145. The lane was inert: realWordTypoMode ACTIVE claimed every DICTIONARY token first and the legacy suppression swallowed it, so OFF/SHADOW/ACTIVE produced byte-identical metrics.
codeChanges: linguistic-rules.mjs: isRealWordTone tokens now run the cascade instead of the DIFFERENT_KEY light path, and fall back to that light path if the cascade declines (lanes compose)
linguistic-rules.mjs: realWordLegacySuppressed no longer applies to isRealWordTone tokens (they passed the stricter symmetric trigram proof)
linguistic-rules.mjs: new realWordBigramProofFail veto - a directly attested ORIGINAL bigram that beats the candidate's blocks the rewrite ('chinh hang' FP)
linguistic-rules.mjs: cheap same-key trigram pre-check mirrors the terminal veto, halving the latency cost of routing these tokens through the cascade (SHADOW exempt)
